text:
maya: heads up — typegen regen in main created a tiny API shape change that broke SDK auth retry headers in the node client :grimacing:
jon: ugh, which change? link?
maya: PR #4121 — the openapi -> typegen mapping started marking `Authorization` as `sensitive: true` which removed it from the default retry keyset
sam: that explains the flaky e2e failures i've been debugging all morning
li: saw CI fail on package-publish job too — publishing script errors out because package.json semver bump didn't land 
ci-bot: Build 2026-03-18T09:12Z failed: package-publish (exit code 1) — log: https://ci.example/rdw/2026/2026-03-18/2026-03-18-0912
jon: paste of the error:
```
> node ./scripts/release.js --publish
Error: Version mismatch: package.json (1.4.0) != tag (v1.3.9)
Aborting publish
```
maya: i pushed a regen commit and forgot to update changelog/semver in the same PR, my bad :/ — created hotfix branch `devex/hotfix-regen-auth`
sam: for the auth header issue — is it safe to treat Authorization as non-sensitive for retry keying? we do need stable retry keys across gateways
li: short term: revert the typegen mapping change and release a patch; long term: add an explicit mapping in codegen config for header retry behavior
jon: agreed, revert + patch publish. i'll open a revert PR and include a CHANGELOG entry noting crash and revert semver
devex-bot: New PR opened: #4130 revert: typegen mapping for Authorization — https://git.example/r/redwood-inference/pulls/4130 :eyes:
maya: thanks jon. after revert we should run `yarn typegen:regen && yarn build` + run the SDK smoke sample app (`examples/onboarding`) — that sample surfaced the retry bug earlier
li: note: `examples/onboarding` uses the node SDK pinned to `next` tag in CI; that made it miss the pre-release fix — we should have sample apps use `file:` or the built artifact in CI instead of remote tag
sam: also saw a weird flake in the publish job where `npm publish` timed out on the registry. maybe load-related. adding retries to publish step would help
jon: plan:
1) merge revert PR (#4130)
2) bump package.json to 1.4.1 and add changelog entry
3) run full regen + typecheck + examples smoke tests
4) publish patch with retry-protected publish step
maya: i'll prepare the changelog blurb: "fix: revert mapping that caused Authorization header to be excluded from retry keyset; fixes SDK auth/retry regressions"
li: i'm adding a CI guard to fail if `typegen:regen` results in any diff without a changelog or semver bump — prevents this class of mistake
sam: small ask — can we add a lint rule in the openapi-to-typegen pipeline to treat header sensitivity changes as semver-major/feature flags?
jon: yeah, make it block merges. we'll sync with eng-releases on policy
maya: for transparency i pasted the minimal regen diff in the PR and included failing e2e link — hoping to keep the revert tiny
ci-bot: CI after PR #4130 created: build queued — will run tests and typegen check
li: if anyone wants to help run the onboarding sample locally, run:
```
cd examples/onboarding
yarn install
yarn build && node ./dist/smoke.js
```
sam: i'll validate the sample and the retry header behavior locally and report back in this thread
jon: thanks all. after publish we should tag and notify the SDK channels so customers aren't surprised by the regressions
maya: noted — will post a short blurb in #general and #support with the patch note and upgrade advice (no API changes, just fix for retry behavior) :thumbsup:
sam: quick question: should we add an automated e2e run that uses the staged package from the registry (npm dist-tag) before flipping the tag? avoids publishing bad packages
li: yes — add a staged-publish smoke gate. follow-up ticket?
jon: created ticket DEVEX-782: staged-publish smoke gate + publish retries + typegen diff guard
maya: ok i'm going to merge the revert once CI passes and kick the patch publish. will update here when done
ci-bot: Build 2026-03-18T09:21Z passed: tests ok. Typegen diff empty.
maya: merged #4130 and published 1.4.1-patch. changelog updated.
sam: confirmed examples/onboarding smoke passes with 1.4.1 locally. retry headers stable :party:
jon: great work. follow-ups: DEVEX-782 and let's add the lint/guard rule in the openapi pipeline next sprint
li: noted for sprint planning. thanks y'all!
